type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: GREEN on Lean v4.35.0: refute the false bebedor, prove the drinker principle

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LeanWinWinLogic.bebedor_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Person : Type} (Drinks : Person → Prop) (x0 : Person), ∃ x, Drinks x → ∀ (y : Person), Drinks y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LeanWinWinLogic.bebedor_original_false
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ¬∀ {Person : Type} (Drinks : Person → Prop) (x : Person),     ((∀ (y : Person), Drinks y) ∨ ¬∀ (y : Person), Drinks y) →       LeanWinWinLogic.WinWin (∀ (y : Person), Drinks y) (Drinks x → ∀ (y : Person), Drinks y)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LeanWinWinLogic.close
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P Q : Prop}, LeanWinWinLogic.WinWin P Q → P ∨ ¬P → Q

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LeanWinWinLogic.heilbronnWinWin
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P Q : Prop}, (P → Q) → (¬P → Q) → LeanWinWinLogic.WinWin P Q

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LeanWinWinLogic.missing_half_iff_target
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Opp Branch Target : Prop}, (Opp → Branch) → (Target ↔ ¬Opp) → (Branch → Target ↔ Target)
